summary: preinstall beacon exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded OAST callback
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=`node index.js`, so `npm install` auto-executes index.js. The script collects installer identifiers - os.hostname(), os.userInfo(), home directory, INIT_CWD, local IPv4 addresses, public IP (resolved via https://api.ipify.org, https://icanhazip.com, https://ifconfig.me), resolver IP, and the parent project's package.json name/author/repository - and transmits them to the hardcoded Interactsh OAST callback da51rv0hb2uc72tg4gvgdepinjcallbk1.oast.fun via DNS-chunked subdomain queries and HTTP(S) POST to /poc/<uuid>. The behavior is not disclosed to the installer and the collected data leaves the host to a third-party callback domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
